title: 第49章 来时候好好的，回不去了
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “首长，那老娘们儿绝对是个庸医！”“陆阳之前出那黑板报你是看过的，那色彩搭配，那颜色用的，怎么可能是色弱？”团部大楼里，刚从会议室出来的副正委谭元洲疾步走着。高峰和何镇涛两人一左一右的追在后头，急匆匆的汇报情况。谭元洲边走边问：“体检医生怎么说？”何镇涛气的不行：“她非说色弱和会画画没关系，我俩嘴皮子都磨破了，硬是不肯在体检表上盖章，还说我们没有医学常识！”谭元洲皱眉：“既然是色弱，那征兵体检的时候，为什么没发现问题？”高峰连忙补充：“我们也说了，人家征兵体检都通过了，你在这卡一下是什么意思？那女的非说什么，现在他们现在用的最新款国标色弱检测卡，说那边地方医院肯定用的还是老款。”“反正我听她那意思，是觉着陆阳是花钱走后门才进来的，所以铁了心的要把人弄走。”谭元洲蹬蹬蹬上楼：“那究竟，有没有这么回事，你们调查清楚了吗？”何镇涛连忙跟上，用力摇头：“绝无可能！陆阳的背景资料我是看过的，父亲是轴承锻造厂的普通职工，母亲早早就下岗了，是个个体户。”“风里来雨里去，赚的都是辛苦钱，夫妻俩都是再普通不过的家庭，哪里认识什么人？”“他们班长周凯东，当初就负责陆阳的家访工作；说原本家里准备花钱让他复读的，是他自已主动要求来当的兵。”“正好镇上有名额，村干部手里也有指标，就这么顺理成章的过来了，压根就不需要找人走关系；完全清清白白的一个兵，没有一丁点瑕疵。”来到四楼，谭元洲停下脚步，回头看着满脸焦急的二人。“你们的具体诉求是什么，是想让我出面做做人家思想工作，还是怎么说？”“我们想把这个兵留下，让他继续正常服役！”二人异口同声，引得走廊里其他军官纷纷扭过头，好奇的冲着这边张望。谭元洲见他俩如此默契，倒是挺意外：“好像很少见你俩能在一件事上这么统一？”高峰也是豁出去了：“首长，这个兵除了体质弱了点，其他一点儿毛病没有！”“踏实肯干，不骄不躁，勤学好问，还特别能扛事儿，未来肯定会是个非常优秀的侦察兵！”“只要好好培养，将来甚至能够成为下一个小郭，成为我们装甲七连的标兵！”“嚯，期望不小啊！”谭元洲显然是没料到一向高要求的七连长，竟对一个入伍才一个月的新兵，给予这么高的评价？但最吃惊的还得是何镇涛，他怎么都没想到居然会在这时候遭遇背刺！还说没惦记我的兵？露馅了吧！谭元洲让俩人在走廊上等着，自已则去团长办公室请示汇报。人前脚刚进去，后脚何镇涛就再也忍不住了。“好哇，狐狸尾巴终于露出来了！”“高峰啊高峰，我是真没想到，你个浓眉大眼的家伙，居然也玩刨墙根这一套？”高峰先前也是一时嘴快，不小心就把心里话吐露出来了。但为了稳住何镇涛，他也准备了一套说辞。说他故意这么讲，就是为了凸显这个新兵的重要性，引起上级重视。总之，先把人留下来再说，要是真的被退回去，那就是部队的损失。何镇涛也是半信半疑：“这么说，你这是在帮我？”高峰一本正经：“我是在帮部队！团里不是缺个会画画的吗，回头黑板报又得找隔壁团借人，每回都得瞧人家脸色。”“行了，别用这种眼光看我，我真不是那样的人。”“你发誓？”“哎呀，别闹。”“谁跟你闹了？我警告你，打谁的主意，都不准打陆阳的主意！”何镇涛气势汹汹的：“当什么都不当侦察兵？天天二两土，风里来雨里去，坐个战车脑浆子都快摇出来了！”高峰没好气的敷衍：“对对对，就该坐在办公室里吹空调，看报纸，写写画画才舒服。”何镇涛瞪着他：“抓笔杆子，有什么不好？”高峰：“枪杆子，比笔杆子差哪儿了？”外头两人的争执声，让办公室里刚听完汇报的团长不由得笑出了声。汪重喜点了根烟，笑呵呵的指了指门外头：“看来，这个新兵，还是蛮讨喜的嘛？要是没人拦着，他们两个怕是能在我这打起来。”“我就不信了，一个新兵而已，能有这么抢手？”谭元洲：“那个兵确实看着比其他新兵更稳重，成熟一些，没那么焦躁。”汪重喜问：“莫不是装出来的哟？”谭元洲摇头，这他就不清楚了。他和那个兵接触的并不多，只是远远看过两眼。更多的印象，还是来自两个新兵连主官的具体描述。“团长，这件事，您看怎么处理？”“这样吧，你去找那个医生谈一哈，让她先盖个章。”“她要是不同意呢？”“那你就动之以情，晓之以理，摆事实，讲道理。色弱而已，又不是什么特别严重的问题，不能因为一点小事毁了一个年轻人的一辈子。”“好，我现在就去。”谭元洲起身刚要离开，就又被喊住。汪重喜冲着烟灰缸，弹了弹烟灰，问了一句。“你先前说的那个新兵，叫么个名字？”“陆阳。”“你把外头那两个，把这个陆阳喊到到我跟前来，我要看一下。我倒是要看看，这个新兵到底有么个过人之处，是不是长了三头六臂？”“是。”“陆阳......陆阳？名字倒是蛮熟悉的？”......与此同时，团部东边林荫道旁。陆阳正闷闷不乐的坐在花坛边。两手托着腮帮子，一脸颓废。周凯东给他递了瓶水，同样心烦意乱的。昨天电话里，他才说的要来接陆阳回去。结果来时候好好的，回不去了？“别想了，连长指导员已经去找团领导了，肯定不会把你退回去的。”“谢谢班长。”陆阳接过水，喝了一口，然后就不再说话了。孔垄在边上提议：“实在不行，咱去把那表格偷出来，把那章盖上去不就行了？”“哪有那么容易，再说，这也不是盖不盖章的事儿？”“要真是定下来，横竖得把人退回去。”“不然狸猫换太子，找个人来顶替陆阳？”“你当凑人头呢？再说换谁，换你？”“不知道我能不能顶得住，我犯的错误多？”丁腾飞刚开口，就被周凯东毫不客气的喷了一顿。“想得美的你，正好如你意了是不是？上一边儿待着去！”丁腾飞眼角抽动了两下，再度开启静音模式。面对大家变着法儿的安慰，陆阳内心更加舍不得这里。好不容易从陌生到熟悉，也渐渐喜欢上部队的氛围。先前去体检的时候，他其实就有点儿担心。因为之前入伍征兵体检，就曾出现过类似问题。只是那个医生用的色卡相对简单，上头只有一个数字，并且卡的没那么严格，却没想到这回碰上个较真的。如果真的严格按照征兵条例来执行，陆阳这种确实有一定概率会被退兵处理，打回原籍。可好不容易在这干出点儿成绩来，当上了副班长，还没当上排长，还没立功表现呢，他怎么可能甘心？正在这时，连长和指导员一路小跑过来，众人连忙围上去追问情况。高峰说：“副政委亲自去做工作了，具体情况还不清楚。”何镇涛拉着他的手：“快，跟我们走，团长要见你。”眼看着陆阳被俩人拉走，众人这心也跟着悬了起来。原先，他们还担心班长会不会被换掉，结果现在却成了陆阳要被退兵？这事儿整的，也太闹腾了！但事到如今，大家也只能用“好事多磨”这四个字来安慰自已，期望着一切能往好的方向发展吧。丁腾飞则是在想，如果是自已被退兵，班长，连长，指导员，也会像现在这般焦急吗？这一刻，他莫名的有些羡慕陆阳，羡慕他能够被这么多关心和在乎的人包围。......“进去吧，团长在里头等你。”“别紧张，团长人很和蔼的，自然点就行。”“是。”陆阳看了眼门牌上的团长室三个字，内心有点儿忐忑。倒不是忐忑要见到特三团的团长，而是担心团长要找他聊关于退兵的事儿。如果真是那样，那陆阳只能出绝招了，只是那招杀伤力太大.....陆阳深吸一口气，轻轻敲门，里头很快传来一道声音。“进来。”陆阳觉得有点儿耳熟，却想不起在哪儿听过。他推门进去，一个圆头圆脑挂着上校军衔的中年人正在低头写字。陆阳刚喊了声报告，对方便放下笔抬起了头。下一秒，两个人全都呆愣住。“老板？”“哎哟，原来是你哦！”
content_en: "Chief, that bitch is definitely a quack!" "You have seen the blackboard newspaper that Lu Yang published before. The color matching and the colors used, how could it be color weakness?" In the regiment building, Deputy Chairman Tan Yuanzhou, who had just come out of the conference room, was walking quickly.Gao Feng and He Zhentao followed behind, reporting the situation in a hurry.Tan Yuanzhou asked as he walked: "What did the medical examiner say?" He Zhentao was very angry: "She insisted that color weakness has nothing to do with being able to draw. We both were so embarrassed that we refused to stamp the physical examination form and said we had no medical knowledge!" Tan Yuanzhou frowned: "Since it is color weakness, why didn't the problem be found during the physical examination?" Gao Feng quickly added: "We also said that they are recruiting soldiers.The physical examination passed, what do you mean by being stuck here?What did the woman say? The latest national standard color weakness test card they are using now, she said that the local hospital over there must still be using the old one.""Anyway, I heard what she meant, she thought that Lu Yang came in through the back door, so I was determined to get rid of him." Tan Yuanzhou stomped upstairs: "So, is this the case?"Have we investigated clearly?"He Zhentao quickly followed and shook his head: "It's absolutely impossible! I have read Lu Yang's background information. His father was an ordinary employee in the bearing forging factory, and his mother was laid off early and was self-employed."Lu Yang's home visit work; he said that the soldier who his family originally planned to pay for him to repeat his studies was the one who volunteered to be a soldier."There happened to be a quota in the town, and the village cadres also had quotas, so it was just a matter of course. There was no need to find anyone to get involved with; a completely innocent soldier, without any flaws."When he arrived at the fourth floor, Tan Yuanzhou stopped and looked back at the two men with anxious faces."What is your specific request? Do you want me to come forward to do ideological work for others, or what do you say?" "We want to keep this soldier and let him continue to serve normally!" The two said in unison, causing other officers in the corridor to turn their heads and look here curiously.Tan Yuanzhou was surprised to see such a tacit understanding between the two of them: "It seems it's rare to see you two so unified on one thing?" Gao Feng was also willing to go all out: "Commander, this soldier has nothing wrong with him except for his weak constitution!" "Be down-to-earth and hard-working, neither arrogant nor impetuous, diligent in learning and asking questions, and very capable of taking on tasks. He will definitely have a bright future.He will be a very good scout!" "As long as he is trained well, he can even become the next Xiao Guo and become the pacesetter of our 7th Armored Company!" "Oh, the expectations are not small!" Tan Yuanzhou obviously did not expect that the commander of the 7th Company, who has always been in high demand, would give such a high evaluation to a recruit who has only been in the army for a month.But the most surprised person was He Zhentao. He never expected that he would be stabbed in the back at this time!You said you didn't care about my soldiers?It’s revealed!Tan Yuanzhou asked the two of them to wait in the corridor while he went to the group leader's office to ask for instructions and report.As soon as the person's front foot entered, He Zhentao could no longer hold back his back foot."Okay, the fox's tail is finally exposed!" "Gaofeng, Gaofeng, I really didn't expect that you, a guy with thick eyebrows and big eyes, would actually do this trick of digging at the root of the wall?" Gao Feng was also quick-tongued before, and accidentally revealed what was on his mind.But in order to stabilize He Zhentao, he also prepared a set of rhetoric.It is said that he said this deliberately to highlight the importance of this recruit and attract the attention of his superiors.In short, let's keep the people behind first. If they are really sent back, it will be a loss for the troops.He Zhentao was also dubious: "So, you are helping me?" Gao Feng said seriously: "I am helping the army! Isn't there a shortage of people in the group who can draw? When I go back to the blackboard report, I have to borrow someone from the group next door, and I have to look at their faces every time."Okay, don't look at me like that. I'm really not that kind of person.""Oh, don't make trouble.""I'm warning you, don't take advantage of Lu Yang!""Do you want to be a scout for nothing? You have two ounces of soil every day, come and go in the wind and rain, just sit in a chariot and your brain will be shaken out!" Gao Feng said angrily: "Yes, yes, you should sit in the office and blow on the air conditioner, read newspapers, and write and draw.Painting is comfortable." He Zhentao stared at him: "What's wrong with holding a pen?" Gao Feng: "How is a gun worse than a pen?" The argument between the two people outside made the team leader in the office laugh.Wang Chongxi lit a cigarette and pointed outside the door with a smile: "It seems that this recruit is quite lovable? If no one stops me, the two of them might start a fight here." "I don't believe it, he's just a recruit., how can he be so popular?" Tan Yuanzhou: "That soldier does look more stable, more mature, and less anxious than the other recruits." Wang Chongxi asked, "Is it just pretending?" Tan Yuanzhou shook his head, he didn't know.He didn't have much contact with that soldier, he only glanced at it from a distance.More impressions came from the specific descriptions of the two recruit company commanders."Captain, how do you think this matter should be handled?" "Let's go talk to the doctor and let her stamp it first." "What if she doesn't agree?" "Then you should be emotional, rational, present the facts, and reason. It's just sexual weakness, and it's not a particularly serious problem. You can't ruin a young man's life because of a trivial matter." "Okay, I'll go now." Tan Yuanzhou stood up and was about to leave when he was stopped again.Wang Chongxi flicked the ashes into the ashtray and asked."What's the name of the recruit you mentioned earlier?" "Lu Yang." "You call the two people outside and call this Lu Yang to me. I want to take a look. I want to see what's special about this recruit. Does he have three heads and six arms?" "Yes." "Lu Yang...Lu Yang? The name is quite familiar?"... At the same time, beside the boulevard to the east of the regiment headquarters.Lu Yang was sitting by the flower bed gloomily.He held his cheeks with both hands and looked decadent.Zhou Kaidong handed him a bottle of water, also upset.Yesterday, he said on the phone that he would come to take Lu Yang back.It turned out that it was fine when I arrived, but I can't go back?"Don't think about it. The company commander and instructor have already gone to find the regiment leader. They will definitely not send you back." "Thank you, squad leader." Lu Yang took the water, took a sip, and then stopped talking.Kong Long suggested from the side: "If that doesn't work, why don't we just steal the form and stamp it?" "It can't be that easy. Besides, it's not a matter of whether it's stamped or not?" "If it's really settled, we'll have to send the person back anyway.""How about changing the civet cat for the prince and finding someone to replace Lu Yang?" "Are you going to join in? Besides, who should I replace you with?" "I don't know if I can stand it. I have made many mistakes." As soon as Ding Tengfei opened his mouth, he was rudely sprayed by Zhou Kaidong."You're so beautiful, it's just what you wanted, isn't it? Stay aside!" Ding Tengfei's eyes twitched twice and he turned on the silent mode again.Facing everyone's attempts to comfort him, Lu Yang felt even more reluctant to leave here.It took a lot of effort to go from stranger to familiarity, and I gradually fell in love with the atmosphere of the army.When he went for a physical examination before, he was actually a little worried.Because of the previous physical examination for military recruitment, similar problems had occurred.It's just that the color card used by the doctor was relatively simple, with only one number on it, and the card was not so strict, but I didn't expect to encounter a more serious one this time.If the conscription regulations are strictly followed, there is a certain probability that Lu Yang will be discharged from the army and sent back to his place of origin.But after finally achieving some results here, he became the deputy squad leader, but he has not yet become the platoon leader and has not performed any meritorious service. How could he be willing to do so?At this moment, the company commander and instructor trotted over, and everyone quickly gathered around to ask about the situation.Gao Feng said: "The deputy political commissar went to do the work in person. The specific situation is not clear yet." He Zhentao took his hand: "Quick, come with us, the leader wants to see you." Seeing Lu Yang being pulled away by the two men, everyone's hearts became anxious.Originally, they were worried about whether the squad leader would be replaced, but now it turns out that Lu Yang is about to be withdrawn from the army?This thing is so noisy!But now, everyone can only use the words "good things come hard" to comfort themselves, hoping that everything will develop in a good direction.Ding Tengfei was thinking, if he was dismissed, would the squad leader, company commander, and instructor be as anxious as he is now?At this moment, he was inexplicably envious of Lu Yang, envious that he could be surrounded by so many people who cared about him...."Go in, the captain is waiting for you inside." "Don't be nervous, the captain is very kind, just be natural." "Yes." Lu Yang glanced at the words "Captain's Office" on the door plate, feeling a little uneasy.It wasn't that he was worried about meeting the commander of the Third Special Regiment, but that he was worried that the commander would talk to him about withdrawing troops.If that was the case, then Lu Yang could only use a trick, but that move was too lethal... Lu Yang took a deep breath and knocked on the door gently, and a voice soon came from inside."Come in." Lu Yang thought it sounded familiar, but couldn't remember where he had heard it.He pushed the door open and walked in. A middle-aged man with a round head and the rank of colonel was writing with his head down.Lu Yanggang shouted a report, and the other party put down his pen and raised his head.The next second, both of them were stunned."Boss?" "Oh, it's you!"
